title: MTI WOW! Open a free Mirror Trading International account and start to earn bitcoin a cryptocurrency
description: This is your opportunity to earn bitcoin and, if you like, to grow a desirable business. The MTI structure is suited for this. Find out ...

asr.full_text: we've all heard that we must invest our money but why is it so important investing provides stability of income and long-term growth capital although more than half of the US population invests in the stock market the diversification of investments isn't as impressive did you know that only an estimated 14% of the US population owns crypto? And in Europe, that percentage is even lower, at 9%. That's why companies that focus on educating and welcoming newcomers to the market are positively impacting people globally. One such project is the South African company Mirror Trading International. Mirror Trading International, or MTI for short, is an exemplary story of a company that successfully managed to gain a large following, educated them about blockchain technology and enabled them to start earning a passive income in crypto without having previous blockchain experience or advanced technical expertise. In an ecosystem that becomes more and more dominated by projects using indecipherable tech jargon aimed only at getting the attention of crypto veterans. It's refreshing to see a project that still cares about mass adoption of Bitcoin. Founded in South Africa, MTI quickly gained global recognition and currently, can pride itself with an impressive active membership of over 160,000 people. More impressively, MTI achieved this without relying on fancy gimmicks but rather by adhering to the principle of providing reliable opportunities to everyone. MTI gives members a way to invest in bitcoin without putting in the time and effort. It takes to develop trading skills simply by leaving it to the professionals. The positive testimonials from MTV's members is a reflection of their successful strategy. In addition, the MTV team is very active and engaging members can participate in Zoom calls with trading experts and crypto veterans while improving their blockchain knowledge with educational videos through a dedicated Member's Portal. Such dedication to community building is rare these days and MTI definitely deserves recognition for it.

textual.limitations: The records do not establish whether the account is available, whether bitcoin is actually earned, or what conditions, fees, funding requirements, or risks apply.

textual.observation: The description presents earning bitcoin and potentially growing a business as an opportunity associated with the MTI structure.

annotation.contextual_rationale: This video is scam content because it promotes MTI as a way to earn passive bitcoin income without prior expertise or substantial time and invites viewers to open an account. The sponsored closing screen, MTI branding, sign-up links, membership-scale claim, and positive testimonials reinforce that promotional pitch. The material does not establish actual earnings, account conditions, required funding, or what happens after sign-up.
annotation.fine_grained_rationale: The speaker links MTI membership and bitcoin investment to passive cryptocurrency income, describing the work as left to professionals. The sources do not establish a fixed or guaranteed return.
